title: Titanium Laparoscopic Stapler Anvil
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is selected for Titanium Laparoscopic Stapler Anvil based on its demonstrated biocompatibility per ISO 10993 and corrosion resistance in physiological saline environments. With 900+ MPa tensile and elastic modulus (114 GPa) closer to bone than 316L stainless, stress shielding is minimized at implant-bone interfaces. The stable TiO2 passive film (2-5nm) repassivates within 0.1s if scratched in vivo, critical for Laparoscopic stapler anvil plate. This rationale is driven by laparoscopic stapler anvil plate and fat life requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for surgical instruments geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for laparoscopic stapler anvil application
commonFailures: Fatigue fracture at thread root under cyclic bending - resolved by thread rolling (not cutting) for compressive stress — critical for laparoscopic stapler anvil performance
